title: Our own exercise pictures are made to copy the paid picture supplier's character exactly, and are called ours with no credit
what: About 238 exercise pictures are MettleUp's own 3D renders. They were set up to match the supplier RepDB's drawn man exactly: the same orange tank top, shorts, shoes, hair, outlines, colours measured off 150 RepDB pictures, the same card, floor shadow, size and crop. They sit next to RepDB's pictures and are marked 'ours, no credit needed'. RepDB's free licence allows in-app use of its own pictures but forbids remaking its artwork in another style and owns its database; a near-copy of its character, sold in a paid app, may be seen as a derived work. Nobody has asked RepDB.
expected: Either RepDB says in writing that MettleUp's look-alike pictures are fine, or our own pictures use a clearly different person and style.
who: MettleUp (legal risk with the picture supplier)
how_often: always, on every exercise page using our own pictures
fix_line: Email RepDB to ask whether look-alike pictures are fine, and keep the answer; if not, change our person's look

items.reason: No iPhone build ships yet; this area is plain logic, share pictures and the exercise library with nothing iPhone-only. The rights findings under L12.3 apply the same when it ships.
